basis: historical MCJ candidate in registry/parameter_registry_v0.1.csv; exact definition below is NEW and prospective
scientific_scope: internal rank-coherence test of a BSD-independent j-invariant/conductor graph; NO cosmological data or physical support

arithmetic.numeric: exact integer arithmetic until logarithms; IEEE binary64 for graph distances; explicit deterministic label tie break

mapping.z: principal_arg(j): 0 when j>0; pi when j<0

endpoint.graph: k=10 nearest distinct neighbors by Euclidean distance in (x,y,z)
endpoint.ties: ascending (squared_Euclidean_distance_binary64,ASCII_Cremona_label); enumerate all tied candidates including duplicates; no self

null.name: conductor_decile_stratified_rank_permutation_fixed_graph
null.stratification: sort accepted rows by (conductor,label_ASCII), assign stratum floor(10*i/n), i from 0 to n-1
null.draw_order: for each b=1..999: for stratum 0..9: one in-place independent Fisher-Yates permutation of ranked labels within the stratum, consuming one continuing SplitMix64 stream

inference.family_caveat: A01 alpha=0.01 remains unchanged; A03 uses stricter 0.005 prospectively; do not claim joint or cosmic significance
inference.interpretation: rejecting conditional rank-permutation null would establish only internal arithmetic dependence, not cosmological correspondence
